summary: Unbound rollout snapshot leaves legacy diverter routing after pin removal
description:
Issue summary:

On 2026-03-10 during a scheduled canary promote for tenant nimbus-prod (customer NimbusHealth) a rollout snapshot produced by the control-plane was never committed to the global routing state due to an intermittent API race. Edge proxies in us-east kept an older diverter entry that continued sending ~8% of traffic to the legacy model variant (redwood-rlhf-v1-legacy) even after the pin was removed and the canary was marked complete.

Impact:
- Customer reports mixed-quality outputs for a subset of requests (~6-9% of traffic for the tenant) between 2026-03-10 17:02 and 2026-03-10 17:38 UTC.
- No increase in 5xx errors; client-observed quality regressions only.
- Affected tenant is on Dedicated capacity; potential SLA exposure if not resolved.

Environment:
- Dedicated pool: dp-us-east-03
- Control plane version: v3.8.1-hotfix
- Edge proxy version: ep-2.1.0
- Serving runtime: sr-1.14.0

Steps to reproduce (approximate):
1. Create a staged canary rollout with weight=5% for redwood-rlhf-v2 against tenant nimbus-prod in dp-us-east-03.
2. Complete canary via control-plane promote job.
3. Trigger a control-plane resync (simulated by rolling restart of control-plane leader).
4. Observe edge-proxy route table after resync: stale diverter entry persists for a minority cohort, causing fallback to legacy variant.

Observed vs Expected:
- Observed: Some edge proxies hold an older snapshot and do not pick up the promoted commit; these proxies continue to route a small cohort to the legacy model.
- Expected: After promote + resync, control-plane commit should be applied atomically and all edge proxies should converge to new routing table within 30s.

Relevant logs & metrics (snippets):
- Control-plane commit log: "commit_id=cmp-20260310-77f2 created snapshot but failed to broadcast to some peers: timeout on peer ep-az3"
- Edge proxy debug: "diverter: matched tenant=nimbus-prod cohort=0x5a stale_commit=cmp-20260209-3cf2 active_commit=cmp-20260310-77f2"
- Traffic breakdown (tenant-level): v2=91.7%, v1-legacy=8.3% between observed window.

Initial workaround applied:
- We executed a forced commit broadcast and edge-proxy cache flush for dp-us-east-03 (rolling flush of edge proxies). That reduced legacy routing to <0.1% within 4 minutes.

Current status:
- In Progress: control-plane team investigating broadcast reliability during leader handoff. Edge team prepared an automated flush tool to remediate similar events faster.

resolution:
Workaround and permanent fix in progress: forced commit broadcast + automated edge-proxy cache flush remediated immediate impact. Hotfix PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/control-plane/pull/4123) implements stronger commit ack/retry semantics and TTL extension during leader handoff to prevent snapshot GC before full broadcast.

Follow-ups assigned:
- CP-ENG: merge + canary + rollout of hotfix to all control-plane leaders (Jun Park).
- Edge: add monitoring alert for diverter mismatch ratio >1% for any tenant (Liam O'Connor).
- Support: send postmortem and recommended tenant-side verification steps to NimbusHealth (Aisha Patel).

Ticket closed once hotfix reaches prod and alerting is in place.
